content.user_title: Manage Google Forms from AI workflows
content.value_statement: Teams often need to inspect or update Google Forms without leaving an AI workflow. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the gws CLI for form discovery, creation, updates, responses, and watches.
actual_capabilities: Shows the gws forms command pattern for Google Forms resources and methods.
Lists supported forms methods, including create, get, batchUpdate, and setPublishSettings.
Directs users to inspect method parameters with gws schema before calling an API method.
Supports workflows for form responses and form watches through documented resources.
Explains the create method limit for title and document title fields.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and Google Workspace authentication to be installed and configured.
Does not provide detailed command syntax for every Google Forms method.
Google Forms create only copies title and document title fields.
Requires the shared gws guidance file for auth, flags, and security rules.

use_cases.title: Create intake forms
use_cases.description: Plan a new Google Form, create the title, and prepare follow-up updates for questions and settings.

use_cases.title: Review existing forms
use_cases.description: Inspect available form methods and retrieve form details before making controlled changes.

use_cases.title: Prepare response workflows
use_cases.description: Explore response and watch resources before building reporting or notification workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect form commands
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to inspect available Google Forms resources and methods before I make any changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic form
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Google Form with a title and document title, then outline the next update steps.

prompt_templates.title: Check method parameters
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the forms method schema to identify required parameters for a response workflow and explain each field.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a batch update
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a safe batch update for an existing Google Form, including discovery, parameter checks, and review points.

output_examples.input: Help me inspect how to retrieve a Google Form.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the form retrieval method, checks its required parameters, and asks for the form ID before execution.

output_examples.input: Create a new survey form for employee feedback.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains that initial creation supports title fields first, then prepares a separate update plan for questions.

output_examples.input: Review response options for an existing form.
output_examples.output: The assistant directs schema discovery for response resources, summarizes required inputs, and confirms access before reading data.

best_practices: Inspect help and schema output before calling any Google Forms method.
Confirm form IDs, titles, and intended changes before write operations.
Use least-privilege Google Workspace credentials for form access.
anti_patterns: Do not run write operations before reviewing required parameters and target form IDs.
Do not assume form creation can add questions in the first create call.
Do not expose response data in prompts unless the user confirms the business need.

faq.question: What does this skill help manage?
faq.answer: It helps users discover, read, create, update, and manage Google Forms through the gws CLI.

faq.question: Does it require Google authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI must be installed and authenticated with suitable Google Workspace permissions.

faq.question: Can it create a complete form in one step?
faq.answer: No. The documented create method only copies title and document title fields.

faq.question: Can it inspect method requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. It tells users to inspect method schemas before calling Google Forms API methods.

faq.question: Does it support form responses?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists response operations as a supported Google Forms resource area.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
